# memory.md — System Memory Model

Defines the exact structure of `.claude/SYSTEM_MEMORY.md` that `/init` produces.
Every field must be populated from live repo evidence during `/init`. No placeholders.

---

## SYSTEM_MEMORY.md Structure

```markdown
# SYSTEM_MEMORY — crypto_ai
# Generated by: /init (crypto-memory-architect v1.0.0)
# Repo: mp3nchev/crypto_ai
# Last /init: [ISO-8601 timestamp]
# Staleness threshold: 7 days

---

## MODULE INDEX
# Format: module_name | primary_file | role | risk_level
# risk_level: HIGH = changes cascade to 3+ downstream modules
#             MEDIUM = changes affect 1-2 downstream modules
#             LOW = self-contained, no downstream dependencies

GROUP CANDLE RESPONSES       | row1/GROUP CANDLE RESPONSES                    | Candle batch collector; maps Binance HTTP responses to symbol|interval pairs; positional integrity guard (R-05 fix) | HIGH
BINANCE CANDLE PROCESSOR     | row1/BINANCE CANDLE PROCESSOR                  | Candle normalization, OHLCV extraction, median volume calc   | MEDIUM
EXTRACT 1M PRICES AND MERGE  | row1/EXTRACT 1M PRICES AND MERGE               | Latest 1m price extraction; merges with 2h candle data       | MEDIUM
Bulk Requests Generator      | row1/Bulk Requests Generator Binance Candles   | Generates Binance candle HTTP request params per symbol      | MEDIUM
Separation of Requests       | row2/Separation of Requests                    | Splits symbols into TAAPI batches (2/batch); injects scan_cycle_id; reads TAAPI_SECRET_KEY from $env | HIGH
Cooldown after Batch 6       | row2/Cooldown after Batch 6                    | Passthrough only — N8N Wait node must be manually added (A-07 open) | HIGH
TAAPI RESPONSE PROCESSOR     | row2/TAAPI RESPONSE PROCESSOR                  | Parses TAAPI bulk response; maps indicator values to symbols | HIGH
DEBUG + DE-DUPLICATION       | row2/DEBUG + DE-DUPLICATION                    | De-duplication guard; includes median_volume_1h/2h, latest_1m_price | LOW
Candles Grouping             | row2/Candles Grouping & Latest 20 per Symbol  | Filters 2h candles only; latest 20 per symbol               | LOW
SMA 20 Calculation           | row2/SMA 20 Calculation                        | Calculates 20-period SMA from grouped candles               | LOW
ASSET TIER CALCULATOR        | row3/ASSET TIER CALCULATOR                     | rank_position → tier (1-5 / 6-15 / 16-20); feeds SL multiplier, leverage cap, R/R floor, score floor for ALL downstream | HIGH
ATR Volatility Analyzer2     | row3/ATR Volatility Analyzer2                  | ATR%, volatility_status classification; does NOT output volatility_score (T-08 fix) | MEDIUM
Prepare Tier Data            | row3/Prepare Tier Data                         | Prepares tier fields for Supabase INSERT                    | LOW
Restore Full Data After Tier Insert | row3/Restore Full Data After Tier Insert | Cross-node data restoration after Supabase write; merges 1m prices + median volumes | MEDIUM
ADX Market Condition Detector1 | row3/ADX Market Condition Detector1          | ADX strength → market_condition classification (Scoring Branch 1) | MEDIUM
Adaptive Weights Calculator1 | row3/Adaptive Weights Calculator1              | market_condition → adaptive weight set for 5 scoring components (Scoring Branch 1) | HIGH
MOMENTUM SCORE CALCULATOR    | row3/MOMENTUM SCORE CALCULATOR                 | RSI, StochRSI, Williams%R → momentum_score (Scoring Branch 2) | MEDIUM
Volatility Score Calculator1 | row3/Volatility Score Calculator1              | BBW tier-aware thresholds → volatility_score (Scoring Branch 3); SOLE authoritative producer of volatility_score | MEDIUM
TREND SCORE CALCULATOR       | row3/TREND SCORE CALCULATOR                    | ADX + MACD 2h/1h alignment + EMA → trend_score, trend_direction (Scoring Branch 4); macd_histogram_1h always null — D-01 OPEN | HIGH
VOLUME SCORE CALCULATOR      | row3/VOLUME SCORE CALCULATOR                   | OBV, MFI, volume tier → volume_score (Scoring Branch 5)    | MEDIUM
Price Action Score Calculator| row3/Price Action Score Calculator             | VWAP distance (latest_1m_price), price structure → price_action_score (Scoring Branch 5) | MEDIUM
Merge                        | row3/Merge                                     | SQL COALESCE join of 5 branches; WEIGHTS_MISSING sentinel (A-10); macd_histogram_1h NOT in SELECT (D-01 open) | HIGH
SCORE AGGREGATOR             | row3/SCORE AGGREGATOR                          | Weighted aggregation; T-02 momentum correction; T-03 OBV correction (~4pt overshoot, open); A-10 WEIGHTS_MISSING fail-fast | HIGH
VOLUME PENALTY APPLICATOR    | row3/VOLUME PENALTY APPLICATOR                 | Applies volume penalty to total_score                       | MEDIUM
TP-SL CALCULATOR             | row4/TP-SL CALCULATOR                          | ATR-based SL (no min slDistancePct guard — P-01 open); 3 TP levels; fee-adjusted R/R; 3% deviation guard on 1m price | HIGH
RISK-REWARD FILTER           | row4/RISK-REWARD FILTER                        | Tier-aware R/R hard filter; leverage calculation; TIER_MIN_RR {1:1.5, 2:2.0, 3:2.5} (R-04 SYNC REQUIRED comment added) | HIGH
RISK-REWARD SCORE OUTPUT     | row4/RISK-REWARD SCORE OUTPUT                  | [REQUIRES_VERIFICATION — not directly read]                 | MEDIUM
Technical Level Identifier   | row4/Technical Level Identifier                | [REQUIRES_VERIFICATION — not directly read]                 | MEDIUM
Entry Zone Validator         | row4/Entry Zone Validator                      | Validates entry zone; sets is_valid_entry, entry_calculated flags | MEDIUM
HARD FILTERS ENFORCER        | row4/HARD FILTERS ENFORCER                     | Tier-aware dynamic score floor (ADX-based); volume ratio; R/R re-check; entry validation; entry_calculated guard | HIGH
SIGNAL RANKING & TOP 5 SELECTION | row4/SIGNAL RANKING & TOP 5 SELECTION      | Tier-diversified top-5; Tier3 score floor vs avg-15; allAreTier3 exception | MEDIUM

## DEPENDENCY GRAPH
# Format: module_A → module_B [risk: HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW] [note]

# === CRITICAL PATH (full pipeline) ===
Binance APIs → GROUP CANDLE RESPONSES [risk: HIGH] [positional integrity, R-05 fix active]
GROUP CANDLE RESPONSES → BINANCE CANDLE PROCESSOR [risk: MEDIUM]
BINANCE CANDLE PROCESSOR → EXTRACT 1M PRICES AND MERGE [risk: MEDIUM]
EXTRACT 1M PRICES AND MERGE → Separation of Requests [risk: HIGH] [scan_cycle_id injected here]
Separation of Requests → Loop Over Items1 → Cooldown after Batch 6 [risk: HIGH] [A-07: Wait node missing in N8N UI]
Cooldown after Batch 6 → HTTP POST TAAPI BULK → TAAPI RESPONSE PROCESSOR [risk: HIGH] [429 risk without Wait node]
TAAPI RESPONSE PROCESSOR → Final post to DB (Supabase) [risk: MEDIUM]
Final post to DB → ASSET TIER CALCULATOR [risk: HIGH] [tier sets ALL downstream risk params]
ASSET TIER CALCULATOR → ATR Volatility Analyzer2 [risk: MEDIUM]
ATR Volatility Analyzer2 → Prepare Tier Data → Supabase INSERT → Restore Full Data After Tier Insert [risk: MEDIUM]

# === SCORING BRANCHES (parallel, all feed Merge) ===
Restore Full Data After Tier Insert → ADX Market Condition Detector1 → Adaptive Weights Calculator1 → Merge [risk: HIGH] [WEIGHTS_MISSING if this branch fails]
Restore Full Data After Tier Insert → MOMENTUM SCORE CALCULATOR → Merge [risk: MEDIUM]
Restore Full Data After Tier Insert → Volatility Score Calculator1 → Merge [risk: MEDIUM] [SOLE source of volatility_score]
Restore Full Data After Tier Insert → TREND SCORE CALCULATOR → Merge [risk: HIGH] [macd_histogram_1h null D-01 open]
Restore Full Data After Tier Insert → VOLUME SCORE CALCULATOR → Price Action Score Calculator → Merge [risk: MEDIUM]

# === AGGREGATION → OUTPUT ===
Merge → SCORE AGGREGATOR [risk: HIGH] [SQL null propagation; WEIGHTS_MISSING sentinel]
SCORE AGGREGATOR → VOLUME PENALTY APPLICATOR [risk: MEDIUM]
VOLUME PENALTY APPLICATOR → TP-SL CALCULATOR [risk: HIGH] [tier params applied here]
TP-SL CALCULATOR → RISK-REWARD FILTER [risk: HIGH] [slDistancePct → leverage calc]
RISK-REWARD FILTER → RISK-REWARD SCORE OUTPUT → Technical Level Identifier → Entry Zone Validator [risk: MEDIUM]
Entry Zone Validator → HARD FILTERS ENFORCER [risk: HIGH] [last quality gate before Telegram]
HARD FILTERS ENFORCER → SIGNAL RANKING & TOP 5 SELECTION [risk: MEDIUM]
SIGNAL RANKING & TOP 5 SELECTION → Loop Over Items → Send to Telegram [risk: LOW]
SIGNAL RANKING & TOP 5 SELECTION → PREPARE SIGNAL LOG → Supabase signals_log INSERT [risk: LOW]

# === SHARED STATE / CROSS-CUTTING ===
ASSET TIER CALCULATOR → {TP-SL CALCULATOR, RISK-REWARD FILTER, HARD FILTERS ENFORCER, SCORE AGGREGATOR} [risk: HIGH] [tier_name, SL_MULTIPLIERS, TIER_MIN_RR, score floors all tier-dependent]
Merge SQL → SCORE AGGREGATOR [risk: HIGH] [missing field → null → silent score distortion]
$env.TAAPI_SECRET_KEY → Separation of Requests [risk: HIGH] [key missing → all TAAPI batches fail]

## CRYPTO FLOW MAP
# Where keys, external credentials, and sensitive data flow in this system

TAAPI_SECRET_KEY:
  source: N8N environment variable ($env.TAAPI_SECRET_KEY)
  consumed_by: row2/Separation of Requests
  risk: OLD HARDCODED KEY EXISTS IN GIT HISTORY — rotation required (P0 outstanding action)

Binance API:
  auth: none (public endpoints for candles and symbols)
  futures_endpoint: /fapi/v1/ (required for funding rate — F-01 open, not yet implemented)
  spot_endpoint: /api/v3/ (current, for candle data)

Supabase:
  auth: anon key in HTTP Request node headers (apikey + Authorization)
  tables: crypto_symbols, raw_candles_data, asset_tiers, scan_results [REQUIRES_VERIFICATION], signals_log (new)
  rest_url: https://[project-ref].supabase.co/rest/v1/

Telegram:
  auth: Bot token in HTTP Request node [REQUIRES_VERIFICATION for env var usage]
  endpoint: https://api.telegram.org/bot[token]/sendMessage

scan_cycle_id:
  injected_at: row2/Separation of Requests (throws if missing)
  propagates_through: ALL nodes from Row 2 onward
  critical: loss of scan_cycle_id breaks DB correlation and audit trail

Trading parameters (not secrets, but risk-critical):
  TRADING_FEES: entry=0.00055, exit=0.00055, total=0.0011 (in TP-SL CALCULATOR)
  SL_MULTIPLIERS: {1: 1.5, 2: 2.0, 3: 2.5} (in TP-SL CALCULATOR)
  TIER_MIN_RR: {1: 1.5, 2: 2.0, 3: 2.5} (in RISK-REWARD FILTER AND HARD FILTERS ENFORCER — R-04 SYNC REQUIRED)
  TIER_MAX_LEVERAGE: {1: 10, 2: 7, 3: 5} (in RISK-REWARD FILTER and TP-SL CALCULATOR)
  TIER_BOUNDARIES: {1: [1,5], 2: [6,15], 3: [16,20]} (in ASSET TIER CALCULATOR)
```

## Population Rules for /init

When `/init` runs, it must populate every section above from live repo evidence:

1. **MODULE INDEX** — read each row directory, extract node names and their roles
   from code comments and function names. Assign risk_level based on downstream
   dependency count.

2. **DEPENDENCY GRAPH** — trace `$input`, `$()` cross-references, and
   N8N workflow_node_sequence.md to establish actual chains.

3. **CRYPTO FLOW MAP** — search for `$env.`, API URL patterns, auth headers,
   and hardcoded credentials across all files.

4. **KNOWN FAILURE ZONES** — read CRYPTO_SIGNAL_SYSTEM_AUDIT_REPORT.md and
   CRYPTO_SIGNAL_SYSTEM_FIX_PLAN.md if present.

5. **HOT FILES** — count audit finding appearances per file from the audit docs.

6. **OPEN ISSUES** — extract from CRYPTO_SIGNAL_SYSTEM_AUDIT_REPORT.md
   Section 4 (Priority Summary) and Section 5 (Outstanding Actions).

7. **TIMESTAMP** — write ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of /init execution.
